source.description: Eight simultaneous parts with tempo, programs, pedal, volume, expression, bend and percussion; no MIDI binary
Eight simultaneous parts with tempo, programs, pedal, volume, expression, bend and percussion; no MIDI binary

build.packing: bounded Re-Pair with byte-aligned sixteen-bit rule pairs

verification.reference: Independent uncompressed UM88 JSON, exact tonal/percussion/interpolation arithmetic

source.note: Direct original FluidR3 preset capture. Low register MIDI <63, high >=63; no sample audio is embedded into firmware.
Original GM35; measured low-register profile retained byte-for-byte. Same compact wave is used in both registers; high-register realism was not measured.
Direct original FluidR3 preset capture. Low register MIDI <63, high >=63; no sample audio is embedded into firmware.

arrangementReport.controls: CC7 volume, CC11 expression, CC64 pedal, CC120 sound off, CC123 notes off; fixed-range pitch bend
limitations: Mono output; CC10 pan is reported and not rendered
One procedural percussion generator; a new hit replaces its previous sound
7-bit velocity/volume/expression are quantized to 16 envelope levels
